title: InstantPearlCatch
description: Fabric server-side mod that makes instant pearl catches work in Minecraft.
body:
# InstantPearlCatch

InstantPearlCatch makes instant pearl catches, or IPCs, work in vanilla Minecraft.

Without InstantPearlCatch, vanilla Minecraft prevents consistent IPCs with ender pearls and wind charges.

## Installation

Install on the server or the client for singleplayer. A client-only install on multiplayer servers will not affect server-authoritative projectile timing.

## Behavior

- Allows ender pearls to catch wind charges during same-tick IPC throws.
- Makes IPCs depend on player timing instead of vanilla tick-order variation.
- This is literally not a cheat why did this get featured in a "how to be like rapture" video

## Supported versions

- Minecraft Java 1.21 through 1.21.11
- Minecraft Java 26.1 through 26.1.2

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.18.2 or newer for Minecraft Java 1.21.x
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer for Minecraft Java 26.1.x
